rationale: Rule1: negative-TTL range acceptance on collections+create maps to param_validation/boundary (Type1_IllegalSuccess-ish) -> baseline High; Rule2: collections+create is management/DDL plane, not core data plane (search/insert/upsert/query/get), so unchanged; Rule3: no batch operation amplification; Rule4: doc_verification_result=DOC_PARTIAL -> -1 level to medium, and no crash signals present (all responses http=200, no OOM/panic/SIGSEGV/5xx/container kill) so the forced-Critical exception does not apply; Rule5: single script trigger (total_scripts=1) -> -1 level to low; confidence medium because the defect_type 'semantics'->Type1 mapping is inferred and the evidence shows the invalid TTL was silently dropped at create rather than persisted, which limits real-world impact even though the validation-inconsistency defect itself is confirmed.
